  source: https://github.com/zalo/CascadeStudio

  cascadestudio.wasm  21241345  cecef84e04dee37e11e2edf824746647194346dcc930022b995888d234727edb
  cascade-worker.js     375242  b36e637132d7b94d3e216913184caf38873a44a17353a2295ef0a2f5fd6e54d5

  The worker is esbuild-bundled cascade-core (StandardLibrary, ShapeToMesh,
  FileUtils, opencascade.js cascadestudio glue, opentype.js, potpack).
  WASM is the CascadeStudio custom OpenCascade.js build (OCCT 8.0 via Embind),
  from github:zalo/opencascade.js#cascadestudio-v2.
